title: System design: batch analytics pipeline
summary: Use a repeatable sequence so architecture answers stay structured.

blocks.text: Use a repeatable sequence so architecture answers stay structured.

items: Clarify sources, volume, latency, consumers and compliance.
Choose ingestion mode and failure/replay semantics.
Define raw and curated storage contracts.
Choose compute based on volume/latency/team constraints.
Add orchestration, monitoring, quality, security and cost controls.
